Hey Leute für unser aktuelles Low Budget Horror Fantasy Großprojekt, suchen wir noch Darsteller die schwarze Ritter und Räuber in der Endschlacht spielen, für folgende Dreh Blöcke: 09.10 - 11.10.26, 16.10 - 18.10.26, 23.10 - 25.10.26 auch an einzelnen Tagen wäre möglich. Gedreht wird in 94258 Frauenau, im Bayerischen Wald. Bewerbung mit 2-3 aktuellen Bildern von euch, sowie eurer Körpergröße, Kleidergröße, Schuhgröße an harlekin-filme@web.de oder Harlekin Filme  

Viele Grüße, euer Harlekin Filme Team

Casting Call (Short Film Paid)
Title: ELEKTRIK KATZENJAMMER

Genre: Psychological Thriller

Logline: The humdrum life of a corporate lackey is transformed when he discovers a mysterious cassette tape that brings him uncanny good fortune. However, in following the cryptic instructions the tape delivers, he finds that his newfound lucky breaks have made him the target of something far more sinister… 

Roles:

THE BOSS (Lead) Male, 40-50s, any race

Description: Years of self-preservation in a soulless capitalist bureaucracy have rendered The Boss greedy, insensate, and casually chauvinistic. However, beneath his vulgarity is a keen intellect that is always scanning for leverage and assessing the quickest route to an advantage. He is not outright evil, but his morality is flexible, especially when there is something to be gained, and he has climbed the corporate ladder through a combination of predatory instincts, oily charm, and an uncanny ability to recognize which way the wind is blowing.

LINDA (Supporting) Female, 40s, any race

Description: An ornery corporate matron. Her years of service have made her so indispensable to the company that firing her would constitute an act of administrative suicide. She has no particular ambitions to climb the corporate ladder, as she has already fashioned her little corner of the bureaucracy into a personal fiefdom. She is always prepared to die on the hill of whatever task is in front of her. Blunt, snippy, and occasionally inappropriate, she is in many ways a kindred spirit to the Boss, albeit one with less interest in upward mobility and more interest in making sure everyone else does their damn job.

LUCAS (Supporting) Male, 20s, any race

The yuppie naïf is the only one around the office who has not yet had his spirit crushed by the unending corporate drudgery. Painfully earnest and open-hearted, Lucas believes that enthusiasm is contagious, people mean well, and things always work out eventually. Although his eagerness is frequently mistaken for self-absorption, the truth is that Lucas simply has a lot to say, and he desperately wants someone to be interested. He’s a dewy-eyed idealist who gets excited about Mondays and brings homemade cookies to disciplinary meetings. 

Directed by: Seamus Carroll

Written by: Sam Thompson

Production Company: Rodeo House

Production Type: Indie Film

Compensation: 

The Boss -$250 (~2 days)

Lucas -$250 (~2 days)

Linda -$125 (1 day)

Meals provided 

Union Status: Non-Union

Shooting Dates: Saturday, October 24th and Sunday, October 25th (Subject to change) 

Filming Location: Denver, CO. 

PLEASE SEND:

An email to seamus@rodeohouse.net with

1. Your headshot

2. Links to any monologues/previous work/acting reel

3. Which role/s you are interested in

4. Your availability on Sunday (8/27) for an in person audition in downtown Denver

MY PREVIOUS WORK

THE THREE DOGS (2026)

items.text:
*Maria Canals-Barrera* — aka Disney Channel mom legend.

*In one sentence:* Theresa Russo from _Wizards of Waverly Place_.

*Quick highlights:*

- *Born*: Sept 28, 1966 in Miami — Cuban-American, now 59
- *Famous as*:
    - *Theresa Russo* on _Wizards of Waverly Place_ (2007-2012) — Alex, Justin and Max's mom. The loud, loving, hilarious mom. She just came back for the reboot _Wizards Beyond Waverly Place_ (2024-25)
    - *Voice of Hawkgirl / Shayera Hol* on _Justice League_ and _Justice League Unlimited_ (2001-2006) — iconic if you grew up on DC cartoons
- *Other stuff*:
    - _Camp Rock_ as Connie Torres (Demi Lovato's mom)
    - _Cristela_ on ABC as Daniela — got a lot of praise for Latina representation
    - _The George Lopez Show, The Big Bang Theory, Fuller House, Larry Crowne_ (movie with Tom Hanks)
- *Voice work*: Tons of animation — _Danny Phantom, Static Shock, Batman: The Brave and the Bold_
- *Personal*: Married to actor David Barrera since 1999, 2 daughters. Theater trained, speaks fluent Spanish
- *Vibe*: Super warm, funny, proud Latina mom energy — both on and off screen. Fans love her because she still hangs with the Wizards cast

Basically if you were a Disney Channel kid, she raised you.

*Maria Canals-Barrera* — aka Disney Channel mom legend.

*In one sentence:* Theresa Russo from _Wizards of Waverly Place_.

*Quick highlights:*

- *Born*: Sept 28, 1966 in Miami — Cuban-American, now 59
- *Famous as*:
    - *Theresa Russo* on _Wizards of Waverly Place_ (2007-2012) — Alex, Justin and Max's mom. The loud, loving, hilarious mom. She just came back for the reboot _Wizards Beyond Waverly Place_ (2024-25)
    - *Voice of Hawkgirl / Shayera Hol* on _Justice League_ and _Justice League Unlimited_ (2001-2006) — iconic if you grew up on DC cartoons
- *Other stuff*:
    - _Camp Rock_ as Connie Torres (Demi Lovato's mom)
    - _Cristela_ on ABC as Daniela — got a lot of praise for Latina representation
    - _The George Lopez Show, The Big Bang Theory, Fuller House, Larry Crowne_ (movie with Tom Hanks)
- *Voice work*: Tons of animation — _Danny Phantom, Static Shock, Batman: The Brave and the Bold_
- *Personal*: Married to actor David Barrera since 1999, 2 daughters. Theater trained, speaks fluent Spanish
- *Vibe*: Super warm, funny, proud Latina mom energy — both on and off screen. Fans love her because she still hangs with the Wizards cast

Basically if you were a Disney Channel kid, she raised you.

#act #actress #actor #film #movies

**STOP IMAGINING SOUND. START BUILDING YOUR INSTRUMENT.**

*Online Vocal Coaching Based Purely on Vocal Physiology & Physics*

Welcome to the **Vocal Gym**.

Mirella Freni's student

Guildhall School of Music and Drama graduate

Lunenburg Academy of Music Performance Artist in Residence

Most traditional coaching relies on vague visualizations and acoustic myths (*"sing in the mask"*, *"feel the sound between your eyes"*). Your voice is not a metaphor - it is a biological, physical instrument governed by muscle isolation, air pressure, and pharyngeal geometry.

Whether you are an amateur building your voice from scratch or a working professional struggling with vocal fatigue, real progress comes from concrete biomechanics:

* **Targeted Muscle Isolation:** Isolate and balance the TA (*Thyroarytenoid*) and CT (*Cricothyroid*) muscles to build genuine core power, register balance, and flexibility without strain.
* **Pharyngeal Geometry & Real Projection:** Utilize the pharyngeal resonator and *Squillo* for projection that cuts through any mix - without forcing air or spreading into a smile.
* **Zero Interference:** Eliminate throat constriction, hyoid tension, and tongue root interference at the physical source.
**WHO IS THIS FOR?**
* **Amateurs:** Build a rock-solid, healthy physiological foundation right from day one with zero fluff.
* **Professionals:** Fix stamina issues, expand your dynamic range, unlock effortless *Appoggio*, and gain 100% predictable control over your instrument.

🎁 **FREE 1st ONLINE CONSULTATION**

*30-Minute Biomechanical Vocal Audit & Diagnostic Session*

We’ll analyze your current vocal setup, pinpoint physical blockages, and lay out a clear, objective training roadmap.

📍 **Format:** 1-on-1 Online

📩 **How to book:** Send a DM now to claim your free diagnostic session. Space is limited!

Hey ihr Lieben!

Ich suche nach einem/einer Tonmeister*in für meinen Kurzfilm „Ich warte, dass du (AT)“ 

Der Film erzählt einen Beziehungskonflikt in einzelnen Plansequenzen und beschäftigt sich mit dem Spannungsfeld zwischen Geben und Nehmen. Im Zentrum steht die Frage, wie aus zwei Wahrheiten ein Gemeinsam entstehen kann.

Mit diesem Film möchte ich einen intimen Einblick in den Konflikt eines Paares geben, das über den Abend hinweg immer wieder neu Nähe und Distanz aushandelt.

Dreh: 6.-8. November

Ort: Berlin

Gage: unbezahlt - als kleines Dankeschön lade ich das Team im Anschluss des Aufbau-/Blocking Tags ins Restaurant ein. 

Bewerbungen gerne an: notovaa@gmail.com

Liebe Grüße

Anna

Seeking **London-based actors of South Asian (Indian/Pakistani) or Middle Eastern appearance** for a shortfilm:

**BILAL**
• Male - screen age **60–70**
• An older man experiencing memory loss, with moments of vulnerability, fear and recognition.
• Looking for a grounded, sensitive actor who can convey emotion through subtle expressions and stillness.

**LAMIS**
• Female - screen age **19–23**
• A young woman balancing caring responsibilities with her own difficult personal circumstances.
• Looking for emotional depth, quiet strength and a natural, understated performance.

**PROJECT DETAILS**
• It is a paid opportunity
• Shoot dates: tentatively after 20th Oct

**TO APPLY**
Please email **swatiagarwal.casting@gmail.com** with:
• A recent headshot
• Your Spotlight/profile link
• A showreel or existing performance clip, if available.

**Looking for London based actors only**

**Subject:** BILAL – Your Name / LAMIS – Your Name

Shortlisted actors will receive audition sides and self-tape instructions.

Please share with suitable actors or pass this on to anyone you would recommend particularly for Bilal. Thank you!

Last Halloween, The Devil’s Highway reached over 400,000 views across platforms. This year, I’m aiming to make and release another horror short for Halloween and I’m looking for my team.

CAST:
• NINA - female lead, playing age 22–30
• RUTH - female lead, playing age 30–45
• Two small speaking police roles

All ethnicities welcome. Cast roles are paid.

CREW:
• Sound recordist
• Lighting / gaffer
• Potentially a stunt coordinator for the physical action
• Potentially also mua if budget allows

📍 Blackburn, Lancashire
📅 Proposed shoot: 12–18 October 2026
🎥 One long day or two days. Exact dates TBC.

A small, self funded passion project with an extremely modest budget. Fees, hours and travel agreed before booking.

Link also in bio.

CREW - DM me your availability, relevant work and rates.

Know someone who’d be a good fit? Please tag them or send this their way. 🎃

CAST + CREW CALL!! 'IT CRIES' 🎬🎃

Last Halloween, The Devil’s Highway reached over 400,000 views across platforms. This year, I’m aiming to make and release another horror short for Halloween and I’m looking for my team.

CAST:
• NINA - female lead, playing age 22–30
• RUTH - female lead, playing age 30–45
• Two small speaking police roles

All ethnicities welcome. Cast roles are paid.

CREW:
• Sound recordist
• Lighting / gaffer
• Potentially a stunt coordinator for the physical action
• Potentially also mua if budget allows

📍 Blackburn, Lancashire
📅 Proposed shoot: 12–18 October 2026
🎥 One long day or two days. Exact dates TBC.

A small, self funded passion project with an extremely modest budget. Fees, hours and travel agreed before booking.

ACTORS - details and applications:
Thisistae.com/casting/itcriescasting

Link also in bio.

CREW - DM me your availability, relevant work and rates.

Know someone who’d be a good fit? Please tag them or send this their way. 🎃

SPRING / SUMMER 2026 — CAPE TOWN

A.L.T. is casting female bikini models for an ongoing summer beach photoshoot project starting in October.

Experienced and first-time models are welcome.

PROJECT DETAILS
• Cape Town beach locations
• Shoot days scheduled according to weather & production requirements
• Typically 1–2 shoot days per week, with some weeks skipped
• Approx. 3–5 hours per shoot
• R1,440 per selected model, per shoot day
• No usage fee
• Professional swimwear shoot — no nudity

REQUIREMENTS
18+ • bikini/swimwear-ready physique • confident on camera • reliable • own swimwear + towel

TO APPLY:
DM or WhatsApp 076 180 2729 with:

1. Name and age
2. Measurements 
3. Cape Town location
4. 3–4 recent photos (clear, natural, full-body + close-up)
5. Instagram/TikTok link (not handle)
6. Modelling experience, if any

Selected talent will receive shoot dates directly based on project requirements.

A.L.T. | Astra Logistics & Talent
People. Opportunities. Beyond.

[CASTING CALL] - Short Art-House Film "ONE DAY" (Hartford, CT)
Project Title: ONE DAY (Listed as THE GRIEF WE LIVE WITH)
Type: Non-Union Short Film (3-Minute Art-House / Silent Drama)
Director: Malik Salaam (VLOHART)
Location: Hartford, CT (Keney Park)
Shoot Date: Mid-October (1-Day Shoot, Flexible)
Compensation: Copy, Credit, Meals, Travel Stipend 
 
LOGLINE:
An elderly man sitting alone in an open field faces the quiet weight of grief when a curious young child begins asking questions about a forgotten photograph. Shot in a deadpan, disciplined aesthetic (Wes Anderson symmetry meets Sergio Leone restraint).  

SEEKING:
Pop (Male, 65–80, All Ethnicities): Stoic, expressive, weathered. Holds deep, quiet grief beneath a polite exterior. Minimal dialogue—driven by presence, posture, and micro-expressions.  
 KID (Male, Screen Age 5–8, All Ethnicities): Curious, naive, and unfiltered. Delivers lines with stiff, mechanical precision and deadpan timing. Parent/guardian must be present on set. Light dialogue.  

TO APPLY:
Parents/Guardians & Actors, please send headshots/photos, resume, and any reel/video links to [vlohartstudios@gmail.com] with the subject line "ONE DAY - [Role Name]".

items.text:
📕 APETYT NA ŻYCIE - SZUKAM MUZY NA OKŁADKĘ
Główna okładka mojej książki „Apetyt na życie” jest już zaprojektowana. Chcę jednak stworzyć dodatkowo 10 wyjątkowych, kolekcjonerskich okładek przeznaczonych dla najbliższych przyjaciół - artystów.

Każda ma być inna. Odważna. Intrygująca. Zmysłowa albo przewrotna. Taka, obok której trudno przejść obojętnie.

Do jednej z nich - szukam kobiety, która zostanie moją muzą.

Nie szukam konkretnego typu urody ani wymiarów. Bardziej interesuje mnie energia i to „coś”, czego nie da się wpisać w formularz castingowy.

📸 Sesja potrwa około 1 - 2 godzin.

💰 Wynagrodzenie za udział w sesji: 300 zł.

Po sesji powstanie projekt okładki. Jeśli właśnie - Twoje zdjęcie - zostanie przeze mnie wybrane do finalnej wersji i po zobaczeniu gotowego projektu wyrazisz pisemną zgodę - na wykorzystanie swojego wizerunku na tej okładce, otrzymasz dodatkowe 3000 zł wynagrodzenia za zgodę na publikację i wykorzystanie wizerunku w uzgodnionym zakresie.

Czyli najpierw robimy zdjęcia. Potem widzisz, co z nich powstało. Dopiero wtedy podejmujesz decyzję - co do publikacji w tzw „białych krukach”.

📍 Warszawa / Kraków / Wrocław

📅 20–28 października

W tym czasie będę w tych miastach po powrocie z Bałkanów, więc miejsce i konkretny dzień możemy dopasować.

Nie zdradzam publicznie pomysłu na okładkę. Powiem tylko: nie szukam kolejnego ładnego zdjęcia. Szukam zdjęcia, które przyciąga uwagę.

items.summary:
📕 APETYT NA ŻYCIE - SZUKAM MUZY NA OKŁADKĘ
Główna okładka mojej książki „Apetyt na życie” jest już zaprojektowana. Chcę jednak stworzyć dodatkowo 10 wyjątkowych, kolekcjonerskich okładek przeznaczonych dla najbliższych przyjaciół - artystów.

Każda ma być inna. Odważna. Intrygująca. Zmysłowa albo przewrotna. Taka, obok której trudno przejść obojętnie.

Do jednej z nich - szukam kobiety, która zostanie moją muzą.

Nie szukam konkretnego typu urody ani wymiarów. Bardziej interesuje mnie energia i to „coś”, czego nie da się wpisać w formularz castingowy.

📸 Sesja potrwa około 1 - 2 godzin.

💰 Wynagrodzenie za udział w sesji: 300 zł.

Po sesji powstanie projekt okładki. Jeśli właśnie - Twoje zdjęcie - zostanie przeze mnie wybrane do finalnej wersji i po zobaczeniu gotowego projektu wyrazisz pisemną zgodę - na wykorzystanie swojego wizerunku na tej okładce, otrzymasz dodatkowe 3000 zł wynagrodzenia za zgodę na publikację i wykorzystanie wizerunku w uzgodnionym zakresie.

Czyli najpierw robimy zdjęcia. Potem widzisz, co z nich powstało. Dopiero wtedy podejmujesz decyzję - co do publikacji w tzw „białych krukach”.

LIVE PRESENTERS WANTED – START ASAP 🎥

Swiss Peak is a health & wellness brand based in Huyton, Liverpool, and we’re looking for two confident, energetic Live Presenters to join our team.

You’ll be hosting our live shopping sessions, showcasing our products, chatting with viewers and creating an exciting, engaging atmosphere that keeps people watching and buying.

THE ROLE
We currently have two presenter slots available:
Morning Presenter – 4 hours per day
Afternoon Presenter – 4 hours per day
Monday–Friday | Based in Huyton, Liverpool
We’re ideally looking for presenters who can commit to a regular weekday slot and become a familiar face of Swiss Peak.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR
We want someone who is:

Bubbly, confident and naturally engaging
Comfortable speaking and selling on camera
Genuinely interested in health, wellness and supplements
Able to maintain energy and enthusiasm throughout a 4-hour live
Good at pacing themselves and keeping conversation flowing
Able to get viewers excited about products, offers and promotions
Reliable and comfortable working to a regular schedule

Energy is particularly important during major sales periods such as Black Friday and the lead-up to Christmas, when our live sessions can get especially busy.

Previous live presenting, sales, TikTok Shop, retail, hosting or content creation experience would be a big advantage, but personality and confidence are just as important to us.

PAY
£15–£20 per hour, depending on previous experience.

START DATE
ASAP
If you’re confident on camera, love speaking to people and think you could bring great energy to Swiss Peak Lives, we’d love to hear from you.
Apply with a little information about yourself, your availability and any relevant presenting, sales or content experience.

**STOP IMAGINING SOUND. START BUILDING YOUR INSTRUMENT.**

*Online Vocal Coaching Based Purely on Vocal Physiology & Physics*

Welcome to the **Vocal Gym**.

Mirella Freni's student

Guildhall School of Music and Drama graduate

Lunenburg Academy of Music Performance Artist in Residence

Most traditional coaching relies on vague visualizations and acoustic myths (*"sing in the mask"*, *"feel the sound between your eyes"*). Your voice is not a metaphor - it is a biological, physical instrument governed by muscle isolation, air pressure, and pharyngeal geometry.

Whether you are an amateur building your voice from scratch or a working professional struggling with vocal fatigue, real progress comes from concrete biomechanics:

* **Targeted Muscle Isolation:** Isolate and balance the TA (*Thyroarytenoid*) and CT (*Cricothyroid*) muscles to build genuine core power, register balance, and flexibility without strain.
* **Pharyngeal Geometry & Real Projection:** Utilize the pharyngeal resonator and *Squillo* for projection that cuts through any mix - without forcing air or spreading into a smile.
* **Zero Interference:** Eliminate throat constriction, hyoid tension, and tongue root interference at the physical source.
**WHO IS THIS FOR?**
* **Amateurs:** Build a rock-solid, healthy physiological foundation right from day one with zero fluff.
* **Professionals:** Fix stamina issues, expand your dynamic range, unlock effortless *Appoggio*, and gain 100% predictable control over your instrument.

🎁 **FREE 1st ONLINE CONSULTATION**

*30-Minute Biomechanical Vocal Audit & Diagnostic Session*

We’ll analyze your current vocal setup, pinpoint physical blockages, and lay out a clear, objective training roadmap.

📍 **Format:** 1-on-1 Online

📩 **How to book:** Send a DM now to claim your free diagnostic session. Space is limited!

* **Zero Interference:** Eliminate throat constriction, hyoid tension, and tongue root interference at the physical source.
**WHO IS THIS FOR?**
* **Amateurs:** Build a rock-solid, healthy physiological foundation right from day one with zero fluff.
* **Professionals:** Fix stamina issues, expand your dynamic range, unlock effortless *Appoggio*, and gain 100% predictable control over your instrument.

**STOP IMAGINING SOUND. START BUILDING YOUR INSTRUMENT.**

*Online Vocal Coaching Based Purely on Vocal Physiology & Physics*

Welcome to the **Vocal Gym**.

Mirella Freni's student

Guildhall School of Music and Drama graduate

Lunenburg Academy of Music Performance Artist in Residence

Most traditional coaching relies on vague visualizations and acoustic myths (*"sing in the mask"*, *"feel the sound between your eyes"*). Your voice is not a metaphor - it is a biological, physical instrument governed by muscle isolation, air pressure, and pharyngeal geometry.

Whether you are an amateur building your voice from scratch or a working professional struggling with vocal fatigue, real progress comes from concrete biomechanics:

* **Targeted Muscle Isolation:** Isolate and balance the TA (*Thyroarytenoid*) and CT (*Cricothyroid*) muscles to build genuine core power, register balance, and flexibility without strain.
* **Pharyngeal Geometry & Real Projection:** Utilize the pharyngeal resonator and *Squillo* for projection that cuts through any mix - without forcing air or spreading into a smile.
* **Zero Interference:** Eliminate throat constriction, hyoid tension, and tongue root interference at the physical source.
**WHO IS THIS FOR?**
* **Amateurs:** Build a rock-solid, healthy physiological foundation right from day one with zero fluff.
* **Professionals:** Fix stamina issues, expand your dynamic range, unlock effortless *Appoggio*, and gain 100% predictable control over your instrument.

🎁 **FREE 1st ONLINE CONSULTATION**

*30-Minute Biomechanical Vocal Audit & Diagnostic Session*

We’ll analyze your current vocal setup, pinpoint physical blockages, and lay out a clear, objective training roadmap.

📍 **Format:** 1-on-1 Online

📩 **How to book:** Send a DM now to claim your free diagnostic session. Space is limited!

CASTING CALL | DORTMUND | No-Budget-Kurzfilm (Thriller/Horror)
Für unseren atmosphärischen Indie-Kurzfilm Haunted Guilt (das Debüt-Projekt von Umbra Refugium Films) suchen wir im Raum Dortmund noch markante Darsteller für zwei prägende Rollen.

⚠️ Wichtiger Hinweis: Es handelt sich hierbei um eine unabhängige No-Budget-Produktion. Wir suchen passionierte Schauspieler, die Lust haben, ein handgemachtes, spannendes Projekt im Ruhrgebiet zum Leben zu erwecken.

Gesuchte Rollen:

WOLFGANG (Spielalter: ca. 50 + Jahre)

Charakter/Profil: Markant, geheimnisvoll, getrieben. Wolfgang trägt eine innere Schwere mit sich herum, die ihn undurchschaubar und gefährlich wirken lässt. Er hat eine intensive, zurückhaltende Präsenz, die den Zuschauer ständig an seinen Absichten zweifeln lässt.

Anforderung: Gespielt wird ein Charakter mit Ecken und Kanten, der eine zentrale, bedrohliche Rolle in der Geschichte spielt.

OTTO (Spielalter: ca. 45+  Jahre)

Charakter/Profil: Charismatisch, manipulativ, besitzergreifend. Otto ist der Kopf hinter dem Geschehen, ein Puppenspieler mit eiskaltem Verstand. Er verbirgt seine wahre Natur hinter einer freundlichen Fassade, die jedoch schnell Risse bekommt.

Anforderung: Satter schauspielerischer Ausdruck, der die psychologische Spannung und den Horror des Thrillers trägt.

Eckdaten:

Projekt: Haunted Guilt (Kurzfilm / Psychothriller)

Ort: Dortmund & Umgebung

Gagen: Unbezahltes Indie-/No-Budget-Projekt Verpflegung am Set inklusive

Drehzeitraum: 10-18 Oktober

Du hast Lust auf ein ambitioniertes, eigenständiges Projekt mit starkem visuellen Look und möchtest Teil unseres Teams werden?

Schreib uns gerne eine Nachricht mit deinen aktuellen Sedcard-Fotos / Showreel an:

📧 philippbrendel2@gmail.com

Wir freuen uns auf eure Bewerbungen!

Anbei noch ein kurzer atmosphärischer teaser Trailer!!

CASTING CALL | DORTMUND | No-Budget-Kurzfilm (Thriller/Horror)
Für unseren atmosphärischen Indie-Kurzfilm Haunted Guilt (das Debüt-Projekt von Umbra Refugium Films) suchen wir im Raum Dortmund noch markante Darsteller für zwei prägende Rollen.

⚠️ Wichtiger Hinweis: Es handelt sich hierbei um eine unabhängige No-Budget-Produktion. Wir suchen passionierte Schauspieler, die Lust haben, ein handgemachtes, spannendes Projekt im Ruhrgebiet zum Leben zu erwecken.

Gesuchte Rollen:

WOLFGANG (Spielalter: ca. 50 + Jahre)

Charakter/Profil: Markant, geheimnisvoll, getrieben. Wolfgang trägt eine innere Schwere mit sich herum, die ihn undurchschaubar und gefährlich wirken lässt. Er hat eine intensive, zurückhaltende Präsenz, die den Zuschauer ständig an seinen Absichten zweifeln lässt.

Anforderung: Gespielt wird ein Charakter mit Ecken und Kanten, der eine zentrale, bedrohliche Rolle in der Geschichte spielt.

OTTO (Spielalter: ca. 45+  Jahre)

Charakter/Profil: Charismatisch, manipulativ, besitzergreifend. Otto ist der Kopf hinter dem Geschehen, ein Puppenspieler mit eiskaltem Verstand. Er verbirgt seine wahre Natur hinter einer freundlichen Fassade, die jedoch schnell Risse bekommt.

Anforderung: Satter schauspielerischer Ausdruck, der die psychologische Spannung und den Horror des Thrillers trägt.

Eckdaten:

Projekt: Haunted Guilt (Kurzfilm / Psychothriller)

Ort: Dortmund & Umgebung

Gagen: Unbezahltes Indie-/No-Budget-Projekt Verpflegung am Set inklusive

Drehzeitraum: 10-18 Oktober

Du hast Lust auf ein ambitioniertes, eigenständiges Projekt mit starkem visuellen Look und möchtest Teil unseres Teams werden?

Schreib uns gerne eine Nachricht mit deinen aktuellen Sedcard-Fotos / Showreel an:

📧 philippbrendel2@gmail.com

Wir freuen uns auf eure Bewerbungen!

Anbei noch ein kurzer atmosphärischer teaser Trailer!!

🎬 CASTING CALL | BERLIN

We are looking for **two actors** for our student short film **PUTZFRAU**, produced as part of our **Beta Project at FilmArche**.

📍 Berlin
🎥 Shooting: **27–29 November 2026**
💰 Unpaid student production

**MALE LEAD | 35–40**

We are looking for someone who presents as **Greek, Spanish, Italian or Southeastern European**, with **dark hair and a medium build**.

The role includes a scene involving physical confrontation, which will be choreographed. Acting experience is welcome but not required.

**FEMALE ROLE | 40–50**

We are looking for a **German woman**, playing age 40–50.
The role has **very little dialogue**.

**ABOUT THE FILM**

After a backbreaking day at work, an immigrant cleaner’s simmering rage overflows when he encounters a wounded German protester who becomes the target of his fury.

The film explores how financial hardship, systemic marginalization and social exclusion can contribute to anger and radicalization.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Please send:

📸 A recent photo
🎭 A short introduction
📅 Your availability for **27–29 November**

📩 **[zelihacenkci@outlook.com](mailto:zelihacenkci@outlook.com)**** OR Facebook DM! **

Previous acting experience is not required.

If you know someone who might be a good fit, please feel free to **share this post or tag them**. Thank you! 🖤

sharedPost.text:
ATELIERS THÉÂTRE - ADULTES

Quand ?
Tous les samedis matins de 10h à 12h

Où ?
Au TNR, 3-5 rue Péan, 75013 Paris // Métro : Porte d’Ivry (Ligne 7)

Combien ?
180€ par trimestre + 10€ d’adhésion.
Il est possible d’avoir un tarif préférentiel selon votre coefficient familial (égal ou inférieur au QF4).

Le cours d’essai est gratuit !

Inscriptions, contactez Andréa : 06 32 07 69 48 // andrea.fulconis2@gmail.com

DESCRIPTIF

Le cours est ouvert à tous les adultes de 18 à 99 ans, désireux de rencontrer - ou de re-rencontrer - le théâtre.

- L’année sera divisée en deux parties - 

De septembre à décembre, nous travaillerons les outils du comédien par le biais d’exercices et d’improvisations (seul, à plusieurs, ou en collectif). Nous aborderons le corps et la voix de l’acteur, mais aussi son rapport à l’espace, à l’autre, au public, au silence... À travers cette recherche préliminaire, nous souderons le groupe. Le collectif sera notre maître-mot : c’est ensemble que l’on apprendra et que l’on grandira au plateau. L’objectif étant de monter une pièce ensemble durant la deuxième partie de l’année.

De janvier à juin, nous monterons, en effet, un spectacle à partir d’un texte d’auteur. Classique ou contemporain, comique ou tragique, nous trouverons l’auteur qui vous fait envie, la langue que vous voulez porter, l’histoire que vous voulez défendre ! Nous entamerons, alors, un travail précis d’interprétation du texte et de personnages, à travers une mise en scène crée sur mesure pour votre groupe. Un langage commun et une esthétique propre à la création nous rassemblera.

Plusieurs représentations sont prévues à la fin de l’année : nous jouerons notre pièce plusieurs fois devant un public bienveillant !

LA PROF - Andréa Fulconis

En parallèle d’un Master de Littérature Française à La Sorbonne, Andréa se forme aux Conservatoires d’Art Dramatique (CRD de Cannes, CRR de Nice et CRD de Bobigny). Puis, elle intègre l’École Internationale de Théâtre Jacques Lecoq, célèbre école de jeu corporel. Enfin, elle intègre la LUDI (Ligue Universitaire d’improvisation d’Île-de-France) et se perfectionne en improvisation.

Elle travaille, par la suite, pour plusieurs compagnies d’île-de-France en tant que comédienne, improvisatrice et metteuse en scène, comme Tonnerre de Singe, La Mazane ou Les Loups-Graou, qui sont tout autant d’espaces et des foyers de création lui permettant de développer sa recherche artistique.

La pédagogie prend également une place importante dans sa vie puisqu’elle est professeure de théâtre et d’improvisation pour la Cie Maya, la Ludo Impro’, La Mazane, et désormais au TNR, pour la Compagnie Tonnerre de Singe

Riche de toutes ces expériences, Andréa mêle, dans ses cours de théâtre, un travail précis de texte - hérité de sa formation classique - à une recherche vivante et corporelle, telle qu’elle s’en est emparée par la suite dans son travail artistique. Ses cours sont, pour elle, un espace de recherche à part entière, au même titre qu’une création professionnelle.

🎬 Carrelage Audois
Quand tradition, modernité… 

Entre le charme médiéval de Carcassonne et la modernité élégante du showroom CARRELAGE AUDOIS, nous avons imaginé un film où un chevalier un brin rustre se heurte aux ambitions déco de sa dame, dans une aventure pleine d’humour et de contraste.

Et pour donner vie à cette histoire, j’ai pu compter sur ma belle bande d’extraordinaires farfadés mon équipe joyeuse, créative et délicieusement décalée, qui transforme chaque tournage en épopée aussi folle que fabuleuse.

Un projet qui célèbre la créativité, l’ingéniosité et le plaisir de raconter des histoires avec personnalité.

✨ Un film signé Black & White Pictures, où tradition et modernité s’entremêlent avec style, humour… et un farfadisme pleinement assumé.

Room to Become — Paid Casting Overview
Project type

Commercial / branded short film. ~60-second hero spot with :30, :15, and :06 cutdowns, shot in 16:9 and 9:16 for paid media, social, connected TV, and web.

Project description

A 60-second brand film for a national student housing company, set in a single apartment over the course of a school year, with limited dialogue.

The story follows a college student through the everyday moments of living on their own with roommates. Over the year, an empty apartment becomes a home, and the student grows into a more confident version of themselves.

The tone is grounded, observational, and warm. We want naturalistic performers who can carry a scene with small, true behavior (a pause, a look, a laugh that runs too long) instead of big acting.

Roles

The Student (Lead) — Plays 18–24, any gender or ethnicity. On screen throughout. Grows from a guarded newcomer into the heart of the household over the year. Needs strong stillness and the ability to play a lot without words. Some dialogue.

The Roommate (Supporting) — Plays 18–24, any gender or ethnicity. Starts as a stranger and becomes a close friend. A quiet, steady presence. Light dialogue.

Friends (Featured, 2) — Plays 18–24. Part of the Student's growing circle, appearing across several scenes. Physical comedy and improv a plus.

All performers must be 18 or older. We're especially interested in hearing from local college film and theatre students.

Self-tape instructions

All roles use the same self-tape. Tell us which role(s) you're interested in, and we'll cast from what we see. Keep it natural, and keep the whole tape under a minute. Phones are fine.

Slate (about 10 sec): Your name, city, confirmation that you're 18 or older, and your availability for the shoot date.

Quiet call (10–15 sec): You've had a rough day and you call home, but you don't want them to worry. Play only your side of the call.

"Hey. No, nothing's wrong, I just hadn't talked to you in a couple days. … Yeah. It's good. It's fine. … No. I'm good. Love you too."

Loud call (about 10 sec): Months later, you call the same person with great news from a packed room.

"I did it — I actually did it! … Come over. To my place. Come celebrate."

Send self tapes and any previous content you'd like reviewed to Ryan.Sundling@AgencyFIFTY3.com.

Union status

Non-union.

Compensation

Paid. Flat rate per role, which includes the shoot day and a usage buyout in perpetuity (all media: paid, social, web, and connected TV). Meals provided on set.

The Student: $350

The Roommate: $250

Friends: $200 each

Key dates & locations

Submissions and self-tapes due: October 8

Shoot: TBD, one day between October 13 and 21. The Student and Roommate are needed for the full day (up to 10 hours, including a meal break); the Friends for about three-quarters of the day.

Location: TBD, in the Denver metro area. One apartment interior. Local hire only; no travel or lodging provided.

Hi! We are seeking actors for our student film, "FIREWALL", shooting in Denver

Logline: During a museum tour, a wealthy woman becomes fixated on a million dollar painting that is hung facing the wall. When her attempts to buy it are denied, her obsession with unveiling the mysterious painting grows.

Synopsis: The moment Anais Poklova lays eyes on the canvas, she will stop at nothing to have it. Titled *The Most Beautiful Painting, *and yet, since the artist’s death, nobody alive has seen what’s on the other side of it. Anais makes an offer, but the tour guide, Joseph, informs her that the painting is protected and cannot be bought. Anais can’t accept this. Like fire lighting up dry kindling, her mind becomes consumed by thoughts of the painting, bringing out the worst of her insatiable, deep-seeded need for control. She comes up with a plan, returns to the museum, and boldly offers Joseph a bribe; if he helps her steal the painting, she’ll give him the money he needs to save his family. It goes against everything he believes in, but Joseph and Anais both know that when it comes to family, there isn’t really a choice. Joseph agrees to the heist, and Anais is so close to victory she can taste it. With nothing standing between her and painting, Joseph suddenly realizes that there may be a way to stop Anais *and *keep the money.

This will be an unpaid, reel opportunity tentatively shooting Nov 6-8th with an extra day the weekend of Nov 13th.

Food will be provided and transportation if needed. 

**In-Person auditions will be held on Oct 4th from 2-5 PM at the Central Denver Library in room #242**

**Audition slots can be selected via the link below!**

**Audition reels can be submitted to parranika20@gmail.com!**

[https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfUc6Sqynn5xzrffrVVK8AKNNOpISb1mfBOS4pIUSrARJHOgA/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=111879408904497575567](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfUc6Sqynn5xzrffrVVK8AKNNOpISb1mfBOS4pIUSrARJHOgA/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=111879408904497575567)

CASTING CALL - NYC / Brooklyn

Hey everyone!

We’re looking for an actor for our upcoming indie short film, shooting in Brooklyn on October 14 (night shoot).

Role: Food Truck Owner
Male, 30–50. Arabic accent. A small but important speaking role in an absurd comedy set at a NYC halal food truck.

It’s a self-funded indie project, and we’ll provide meals, credit, and footage for your reel.

You can check out what we’ve been working on here: https://www.instagram.com/ilo.fotola

If you’re interested, please DM me with your headshot, reel (if you have one), and availability for October 14.

Happy to share the script and more details! 🤍

Day 2, Sat 10/10: Basketball boys. Guys who can actually hoop, for a pickup game on the court.
Day 3, Sun 10/11: Mosque men. Men of all ages for scenes at the mosque.
Day 4, Mon 10/12: Aunties & uncles. The community gathered at a family home.

LOGLINE: A teenager’s first pair of self bought sneakers get stolen and getting them back costs more than they ever did.

SUMMARY: UNTITLED: SNEAKERS is about what we hold onto and what we let go. When 14-year-old Nabeel’s hard-earned sneakers are stolen by the neighborhood’s most charismatic troublemaker, a petty feud turns into something neither of them saw coming. 

Rooted in a Pakistani-American Muslim community, in English and Urdu, it’s a coming-of-age story. All will receive full on-screen credit and an IMDb credit, meals provided every shoot day

Cześć!!! 🎬🎥 PILNE‼️
Do najnowszego odcinka Trudnych Spraw, poszukiwani mężczyźni do poniższych ról:

9.MIŁOSZ SĄDECKI (33) – MĄŻ NINY.

WYMAGANE DOŚWIADCZENIE 

SCENY: 1, 2, 4, 6, 11, 15, 19, 20, 22, 24, 25.

WYGLĄD: PRZYSTOJNY, ZADBANY, ATRAKCYJNY, Z NATURALNYM UROKIEM.

SZCZEGÓŁY: WSPÓLNIK NINY, ODPOWIEDZIALNY ZA FINANSE I MARKETING FIRMY. CZARUJĄCY,PRZEDSIĘBIORCZY I TOWARZYSKI, ALE EGOISTYCZNY I NIEDOJRZAŁY. LUBI WYGODNE ŻYCIE I ZABAWĘ, ZDRADZAŻONĘ I MANIPULUJE NIĄ, ŻEBY ZACHOWAĆ DOTYCHCZASOWY UKŁAD.ROLE DRUGOPLANOWE

📆TERMIN 9-10.10

13.TYMON BOROŃ (33) – PRZYJACIEL NINY.

SCENY: 8, 16, 21, 26.

WYGLĄD: ATRAKCYJNY, MĘSKI, NATURALNY, SPRAWNY FIZYCZNIE.SZCZEGÓŁY: RATOWNIK MEDYCZNY I NAJLEPSZY PRZYJACIEL NINY OD DZIECIŃSTWA. LOJALNY, KONKRETNY,ODPOWIEDZIALNY I BEZPOŚREDNI. OD LAT JĄ KOCHA, ALE NIE CHCE ROZBIJAĆ JEJ MAŁŻEŃSTWA.

📆TERMIN 9-10.10

15.FACET SYLWII (30).

SCENY: 10, 13, 14.

WYGLĄD: ATRAKCYJNY, SYLWETKĄ I TYPEM URODY NA TYLE PODOBNY DO MIŁOSZA, ŻEBY NA NAGRANIU MOŻNABYŁO ICH POMYLIĆ.

SZCZEGÓŁY: PARTNER SYLWII. NIE UCZESTNICZY ŚWIADOMIE W JEJ INTRYDZE. BEZPOŚREDNI, SPONTANICZNY,ZASKOCZONY KONFLIKTEM MIĘDZY KOBIETAMI.

📆TERMIN 8.10 

📍Wrocław 

💸gotówka po planie 

📆8-10.10

📩Zainteresowane i dostępne osoby proszę o kontakt w wiadomość prywatnej.

Playing dates 14th December -3rd  January 2027

We are offering an attractive buy-out fee  2, 750 to include rehearsals and shows .

We’re looking for a confident, charismatic performer to take on this much-loved leading role in what promises to be a fun, festive and exciting production!

If you’d be interested in hearing more about the role, production and casting, please get in touch @clemisabellagriff@icloud.com and I’d be very happy to send over further information.

AUDITIONS FOR DEATHTRAP ARE ONE WEEK FROM TODAY!!!
 
Auditions for "Deathtrap"
by Ira Levin

Directed by Chris Bizub

AUDITION DATES:
*Sunday, October 11th from 7:00pm to 10:00pm
*Monday, October 12th from 7:00pm to 10:00pm

CALLBACKS:
Callbacks will be Wednesday, October 14th from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM

PERFORMANCES:
January 22nd, 2027 - February 7th, 2027
Fridays & Saturdays at 7:30 PM
Sundays at 2:00 PM

REHEARSALS:
Rehearsals will take place Sundays thru Thursday from 7:00pm to 10:00pm. Rehearsals begin November 15th.
 
LOCATION:
Chagrin Valley Little Theatre
40 River Street
Chagrin Falls, OH 44022
https://cvlt.org/
 
SIGN-UP FOR AN AUDITION SLOT:
https://www.signupgenius.com/go/30E0548ADAF2BA6F94-64300021-auditions#/

WHAT TO PREPARE:
*Actors should bring a headshot or recent picture, and resume (if you have one)
*A list of conflicts from November 15th to February 7th
*Auditions will consist of readings from the script

SYNOPSIS:
In Ira Levin’s classic comedic thriller, Deathtrap, a washed-up playwright finds a chance to rise to the top once more, a shot he’d be willing to kill for. Sidney Bruhl hasn’t written a hit play for 18 years when he receives a script from a former student, Clifford Anderson, that’s a guaranteed success. His wife, Myra, suggests the two men could collaborate; Sidney jokes that it’d be just as easy to murder the young man and steal the script for his own. When Clifford arrives later that evening, no one--not even the visiting psychic--could predict where the dark events of the night will go.

CHARACTERS:
Any age, race, ethnicity, national origin, gender, body type, abilities, or other identities are encouraged to audition and will be considered equally in character casting, unless directly specified by the playwright as integral to their story. Age/age ranges, genders, and descriptions, if listed, are recommendations by the script but are flexible to interpretation. No roles for this production have been precast unless otherwise stated in marketing announcements regarding the auditions.

SIDNEY BRUHL (Male Presenting. Mid 40s-60s) - A once acclaimed author fallen victim to a recent creative drought. He’s usually the smartest and most charming one in the room and wants to make sure everyone else in the room knows it. Sidney is extremely ambitious and will do almost anything to get what he wants, no matter who might be in his way.

CLIFFORD ANDERSON (Male Presenting. 20s-30s) - An attractive and talented young writer with a bright future ahead of him. He’s usually the smartest and most charming one in the room but is fine with biding his time to let people find that out. He is extremely clever and can easily slip on fronts of innocence and naivety that belies some of his darker ambitions.

MYRA BRUHL (Female Presenting. Mid 40s to 60s) - Sidney’s loving and supportive wife. She is a kind and calming presence during some of Sidney’s stormier moods. Her soft exterior will give way to a much firmer attitude when she needs to get Sidney off of some of his more unhealthy notions.

HELGA TEN DORP (Female Presenting. 30+. Has a Dutch accent.*) - Celebrity Psychic who loves every minute of her fame. She is free spirited, and not easily intimidated.

*Actors auditioning for Helga are encouraged to attempt her accent in their audition, but are not required to if not comfortable.*

PORTER MILGRIM ( Male Presenting. 30+.) Sidney’s friend and attorney.
Very sharp and observant of his surroundings. Isn’t sure he trusts
Clifford. 
 
OTHER DETAILS:
Chagrin Valley Community Theatre is a 501c3 Non-Profit Organization. All actors cast are strictly volunteers. No AEA Contract(s) available.

If you have any questions or would like to audition for this production, but are unable to attend regular auditions, please contact the director at bizchris85@gmail.com feel free to reach out with any questions you may have regarding the production.

Każdy artysta ma w sobie coś wyjątkowego — własny styl, emocje, sposób patrzenia na świat i historię, którą może opowiedzieć poprzez sztukę. 🌟 Właśnie dlatego zapraszamy do udziału w **IV Międzynarodowym Konkursie Sztuki „THE CROWN — KORONA”**!

To wydarzenie dla wszystkich, którzy chcą zaprezentować swój talent, zdobyć nowe doświadczenie i dołączyć do międzynarodowej artystycznej przestrzeni. 🎤🎨💃🎭🎶

📅 **Przyjmowanie zgłoszeń: od 03.10 do 17.10.**

💻 **Konkurs odbywa się w formule zdalnej**, dlatego możesz uczestniczyć niezależnie od miejsca zamieszkania — bez podróży i dodatkowych ograniczeń.

Na uczestników czekają:

🌟 **bez ograniczeń wiekowych**;  
🎭 **wszystkie nominacje i gatunki**;  
📜 **dyplomy**;  
💐 **listy podziękowania**;  
🏅 **medale**;  
🏆 **puchary**.

💛 **Wyjątkowy koszt uczestnictwa — tylko 35 PLN!**

Nie trzeba czekać na wielką scenę, aby zrobić ważny krok w swoim artystycznym rozwoju. Czasem jedna decyzja, jeden występ lub jedna praca mogą stać się początkiem nowych możliwości i kolejnych sukcesów. ✨

Pozwól swojej twórczości wyjść na pierwszy plan, pokaż to, co robisz najlepiej, i dodaj do swojego portfolio nowe międzynarodowe osiągnięcie. 👑

🌐 **Szczegółowe informacje i warunki uczestnictwa:**  
**2gagencja.com**

Organizator — **Ogólnopolska Agencja Sztuki 2G**.

👑🌟 **„THE CROWN — KORONA” — zaprezentuj swój talent, sięgaj po nowe cele i pozwól swojej sztuce zabłysnąć naprawdę królewsko!**

Szukam osób/aktorów w wieku 35+ do nagrywania prostych wideo własnym smartfonem w stylu UGC.

🔴 CZYTAJ DO KOŃCA ZANIM NAPISZESZ

Szukam osób w wieku 35+ do stałej współpracy.  Nagrania to zwykłe wideo mówione (telefonem, bez montażu, bez wrzucania na swoje profile, duża elastyczność i dowolność wyboru scenerii). Wideo będzie wykorzystywane do kampanii reklamowych w social mediach, promujących usługi naszej firmy.

Co jest do zrobienia:

Nagranie krótkich wypowiedzi wg prostego scenariusza (surowy materiał).

Pierwsze zlecenie: pakiet 10 nagrań (15-45 sekund każde) = 500 zł za komplet. 

Przy sprawnej realizacji - stała, regularna współpraca.

Wymagania:

Telefon z dobrą kamerą i czystym dźwiękiem, światło dzienne, naturalność przed kamerą, swoboda wypowiedzi.

Chcesz spróbować?

Wyślij mi na prywatną wiadomość krótki (nawet 15-20 sek.) filmik próbkowy nagrany telefonem - powiedz do kamery jak masz na imię, ile masz lat i np. co dzisiaj robiłeś/aś. Bez obróbki i filtrów. Wybrane osoby dostaną skrypt do pierwszego pakietu.

🎬 CASTING CALL - TWO FEATURED SPEAKING ROLES

We are currently casting two important female roles for our independent feature film N.E.S.T, filming in Chester.

DAKOTA - ELARA’S MUM
Female - Playing age 35-45
Filming - 11, 12, 30 & 31 October 2026

Dakota is Elara’s mum and Malcolm’s wife and plays an important part within Elara’s story.
We are looking for a strong dramatic actor who can bring emotional depth, vulnerability and strength to the role, with believable on-screen chemistry and the ability to handle emotionally demanding scenes.

ELARA’S NAN

Female - Playing age 60+
Filming - 30 & 31 October 2026

Elara’s Nan is one of the oldest people living within the N.E.S.T system. Years within the system have left her frail, exhausted and almost lifeless.

We are looking for a strong actor who can portray this both physically and emotionally, while still allowing the audience to see the person underneath.

Location - Chester
Featured speaking roles
Independent feature film / passion project
Unpaid roles
Screen credit provided
IMDb credit intended, subject to IMDb eligibility and listing requirements

Applicants must be available for all filming dates listed for the role they are applying for and be able to travel to Chester.

TO APPLY
- ONE current headshot only
- Spotlight link
- Current location
- Confirmation of availability for all required filming dates
IMPORTANT - Please do not send multiple photographs, large image files, showreels or video attachments. Emails containing large attachments will be automatically deleted and will not be considered. Please provide links instead.

📧 info@majesticacademyofperformingarts.co.uk
Subject - DAKOTA - YOUR NAME
or
Subject - NAN - YOUR NAME

Joanne Saunders
Casting Director
Majestic Talent Agency | N.E.S.T

Seeking four male actors and one female actress, all ages 30–40, for an independent short-form comedy series about a breakup hotline, to be released on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

Roles: Alex, Daniel, Samuel, Leo, and Monica. Each role is for one episode, approximately 2.5 minutes long.

Language: English. Native or native-level English fluency required, with clear pronunciation and natural conversational delivery.

Format: Voiceover only. Fully remote. All ethnicities welcome.

Actors will record their dialogue on their own schedule, with an estimated commitment of 30 minutes. Professional recording equipment is not required; clear cellphone audio recorded in a quiet space is acceptable.

Unpaid. Credit and a copy of the finished scene provided for reel use. No nudity or explicit content required.

To submit, please DM a brief introduction, the role you’re interested in, and a voice sample or acting clip in English.

items.text:
Hi everyone, my name is Jake, I’m 18 and based in Manchester.
I’m looking to get into acting and would love the opportunity to be involved in any short films, student projects, films, adverts, or small roles around the Manchester/North West area.

I’m new to acting but I’m reliable, hardworking, confident around people, and willing to learn. I’m not currently focused on payment — my main goal is to gain experience, meet people in the industry, and build my skills.

I’m happy to consider:

🎥 Small speaking roles

🎥 Supporting roles

🎥 Short films

🎥 Student films

🎥 Extras/background work

If anyone is looking for someone or knows of any upcoming projects, I’d really appreciate being considered.

Thanks! 😊

topComments.text:
Hi Jake, 

As has been said,  entering the industry isn’t just a matter of doing a post on Facebook & asking for a￼ role. 

As it is, there is an over supply of talented, trained actors in your age bracket  who have acted from an early age & already have agents &  professional credits. 

Young performers up to the age of 17 often have agents who recommend them for young performers’ Spotlight pages. 

Spotlight is the industry professional casting directory & an entry with a professional CV, headshots, showreel is a necessity for all professional performers. 

The industry isn’t crying out for another 18 year old with no experience of stage or screen acting (& taking a wild guess you may be aiming at doing screen acting & appearing in movies or TV soaps or other continuing dramas?). This isn’t being mean. This is the reality. 

Quite apart from the possible dangers & safeguarding issues of doing a post such as yours, getting a job in acting does not work that way. 

Be very careful if anyone seems willing to offer a job to you when you have no experience & no training. Inform any parent or guardian about what you are doing. 

At the moment the casting groups are inundated by posters who have not researched the industry & who seem to think that asking if anyone has ‘small roles’ it will give them more of a chance of getting a role in a production. 

People have no more chance of getting into professional acting that way than asking if anyone can offer them  a job as a reserve player in a top football team with no training or track record as a professional sportsman. 

If you are serious about making a career in acting find out/research the industry & network. 

Buy or borrow from the library a copy of the Actors & Performers Yearbook 2026 (libraries will probably have earlier editions but these will still be useful). Read it & get an overview of the industry & how it is structured. 

If you are still at school or college, seek careers advice. 

Acting is a skilled vocation where practitioners need to train. 

Otherwise reach out to institutions offering performing arts foundation courses & certificates & diplomas for entry into three-year full-time courses at drama schools or equivalent longer part-time courses. 

Contact local theatres & find out if they have any training schemes & drama companies for young adults. 

Drama schools are part of the university system & require GCSEs (including the essential Maths & English), ‘A’ levels & UCAS points. 

There is also the possibility of doing LAMDA certificates which can count towards UCAS points. 

The most cost-effective way to start training & find out if you have a talent for the basics of acting is to join an amateur dramatics society. Even there, it is very competitive & you will have to audition, competing against others for roles. 

For auditions, you may have to practise sight reading (reading roles you haven’t seen before so you have to be able to look at texts you haven’t seen before & show you can understand & read them in character). 

Since Covid many auditions are also held not in person but by self tapes. Actors are sent ‘sides’ - parts of the script - have to learn them - then film themselves & submit the completed tape by the deadline. 

You may find it helpful at first to volunteer to do/learn about doing backstage work in amateur dramatic societies such as lighting/sound/design/set building/stage management &/or shadowing the director in an Amdram group so you gain experience & they get to know & like you. 

Actors have to be reliable, able to learn lines & blocking (movement), not only speak lines convincingly but listen in character to other actors in character on stage. 

They have to be able to accept direction & understand the different techniques needed for stage & screen acting. 

Read & analyse as many scripts as possible. Watch as many stage plays as well as screen productions as possible. 

If you volunteer as staff at local theatres you may be able to see productions for free. 

It is also an opportunity to network with other people who are trying to break into the industry or those who have already trained & can advise. 

Be aware that amateur roles & screen extra/background & supporting artist roles (of which more later) do not count towards professional credits on a professional acting CV.  

You can also reach out to local scriptwriting & screenwriting groups who need actors for table & semi staged readings of new scripts. These may sometimes lead to ‘profit share’ screen or stage projects. 

You can also contact institutions with filmmaking courses & ask if student films need actors. However, again, these are often again very competitive & you are often competing against trained & experienced actors who are looking to do student films in order to get clips for their CV showreel. 

Adult roles in professional productions are rarely cast via open casting. 

Production companies hire professional casting directors who advertise roles on Spotlight, the industry casting directory. 

They look through actors’ CVs, headshots, showreels on Spotlight & contact actors’ talent agents they know asking them to put forward suitable trained, reliable actor candidates for roles. 

They do not risk their reputations by sending untrained people off the street. Trained actors have CVs listing professional credits with the name of the role, the production company, director & date & showreels.

Be careful in choosing courses. There are a lot of predators preying on people’s dreams. Make sure any expensive course automatically qualifies you for a Spotlight entry at the end of the course & holds end-of-course actors’ showcases in front of reputable agents. 

But be aware many talented, trained  actors find it difficult to get agents & rejection is par for the course. 

One route to get professional credits & a Spotlight entry without going on a course is if you are a ‘triple threat’ & can sing, dance & act. 

You may be able to land a job in local theatre variety, children’s shows & pantomimes. 

If you have a DBS, you may be able to join a firm doing children’s entertainment or entertaining senior citizens. 

Otherwise holiday companies may have jobs in hotel cabarets. There may also be jobs in holiday camps & on cruise ships but again you will be competing against graduate Spotlight entry actors, sometimes already with agents. 

Equity is the actors’ trade union & The Stage is the industry trade publication, both of which will keep you informed about industry developments & issues. 

But first of all, seek careers advice about entering the industry & how to train. It’s not a career for novices. 

There are skills & techniques to learn, perfecting the craft,  & many are ready to take your money promising surefire ways to become a actor which turn out to be cons.

No reputable actors’ talent agent will ask for up front fees. 

Agents are looking for reliable trained actors with a Spotlight entry & are a ‘type’ they do not already have on their books & will be in demand. The agents earn when their clients land a job & the agents get commission from the earnings. It’s a business. 

You may be able to get on-set experience by joining an extra/supporting/background artists’ agency which has paid roles but you need good availability & your own transport. Again it is not a route to becoming a professional actor & you cannot use it on a professional actors’ CV unless you are promoted to a minor featured speaking role which is unlikely to happen unless you are a trained actor. 

If you are realistic & find out how the industry works, train & hone your acting skills, you may create your own opportunities & break into the industry. Good luck!!!.

Your first step should be to get some acting training under your belt. In the kindest possible way, there just isn’t enough work around (paid or unpaid) in the industry even for actors with training and experience, so expecting to be offered roles and then learn as you go as someone new to acting simply isn’t realistic. Train first, then try to secure work yourself via open casting calls and/or seek representation from an agent. Extras work is good for getting experience of how a set works, but is a separate strand of the industry, not a gateway into speaking roles.

Vi har modtaget overvældende mange henvendelser, og ser os derfor nødsaget til at lukke for yderligere henvendelser. Tusinde tak for interesssen. 

Vi søger statister til en stor øvelse som afholdes med beredskabsinstanserne i København. 

Rollerne går ud på at spille pårørende til tilskadekomne, nysgerrige journalister, turister og lignende karakterer man kunne se ved en stor ulykke. 

Des mere man kan leve sig ind i en rolle og gør sceneriet virkelighedsnært, jo bedre. Og man skal gerne være i stand til at improvisere.

Man vil skulle spille rollerne foran reelt politi, brandvæsen, og paramediciner. 

Filmen er udelukkende til internt brug.

Optagelserne finder sted den onsdag 28. Oktober 2026 med mødested Nordre Tolbod 29, København fra klokken 10:00 til 13:00 med kaffe og kage efter. 

Jobbet er ulønnet, men vi honorerer indsatsen med et gavekort til en rundflyvning over København med vandflyveren. 

Vi garanterer for en spændende og sjov dag. 

Send venligst pb ved interesse, og jeg vender tilbage snarest muligt. 

Med venlig hilsen
Lauda Waldof

**Budujemy czułą, twórczą społeczność na Mokotowie!**

Czuła Fundacja Centrum Twórcze Przestrzenie

Akademia Sceny wystartowała! Mamy jeszcze miejsca w grupie! Może czakamy właśnie na Ciebie?

Poznaj nas! Jesteśmy duetem twórczym. Działamy od wielu lat. Z zawodu Jesteśmy aktorami. Postanowiliśmy zbudować własną przestrzeń. W poszanowaniu dla granic. Bez przemocy i presji. Tworzymy własny teatr - profesjonalne spektakle. Prowadzimy też warsztaty artystyczne. Zapraszamy Cię do naszej Akademii Sceny. Spotykamy się w gronie dorosłych i młodzieży. Uczymy profesjonalnego teatru. Tworzymy spektakle. Wymieniamy doświadczenia. Odpoczywamy. Działamy w poczuciu bezpieczeństwa i z dbałością o dobrostan emocjonalny. Dołącz do drużyny Czułego Teatru!

Spotykamy się w środy o 17.30 w FORMA Ośrodek Kultury. 

Jeśli chcesz dowiedzieć się o nas więcej, odwiedź stronę internetową:

https://www.czulafundacja.pl/akademia-sceny

Możesz też do nas napisać na: czulafundacja@czulafundacja.pl

Albo przyjść na zajęcia w najbliższą środę!

ZAPRASZAMY!

casting call: non-union / volunteer actor for indie music video

project: music video for a local artist

role: "john" (male, age 40–60+)

shoot location: east vancouver

shoot date: sept 30th or oct 2nd (morning/afternoon — max 2-4 hours)

compensation: volunteer (credit, final video for reel, coffee/snacks)

about the character & scene:

looking for an expressive actor to play john, a weary everyday shopkeeper who hits a sudden moment of pure joy.

the scene: john is sitting at work in his shop checking his lotto ticket next to a framed photo of his daughter. he checks his numbers against the tv, realizes he won, and goes from tired to total ecstatic celebration.

what we’re looking for: solid facial expressions—someone who can sell that shift from heavy exhaustion to genuine, contagious joy. no dialogue needed, just visual acting.

how to apply:

send me a dm with a quick headshot or photo along with your availability for sept 30 and oct 2! 

thanks so much!

PNW EXTRAS CASTING CALL
Production: The Flower Knight 
SAG Micro budget short film, unpaid, credited

Length: 1-2 days, October 17-18 (or just October 18)
Times: 9am call time, 7:00pm finish, with option to leave around ~1pm
Location: Port Orchard - Manchester State Park

We are looking for extras to participate in a fantasy-adventure-comedy short film. 

Logline: Years after abandoning his role as a legendary hero, a reluctant deliveryman is dragged back into his fantasy kingdom’s endless cycle of good versus evil, only to realize the true villain might not be his former nemesis, but the realm’s rigid and stifling expectations.

Food provided, car pools organized as needed. Extras will need to dress according to the guidelines listed below - if you don't have clothing that works, we might be able to provide some. 

Clothing guidelines:
Pants: corduroys, chinos, khakis, skirts (no jeans)
Shirt: floral button up or white/offwhite button up
Shoes: Dress shoes, loafers, boots (no sneakers)

NOTE: This is a fantasy film - if you have any fun fantasy-type costume pieces (like armor, swords, LARP-ing/roleplaying costumes), please feel free to bring those!

If you are available one or both days and interested in being an extra, please fill out the survey linked below and our 2nd AD will reach out with more information. 🙂

Hi! I’m Giovanna, a Brazilian filmmaker and Film Production student at York University, where I study on a full ride scholarship. I’m an award-winning director, writer, and producer, and the first Brazilian filmmaker to receive an award at the international ConnectHER Film Festival.

I’m currently casting for my upcoming short film, *A Happy Kind of Blue*, and I’d love to see your submission!

To apply, please send your **headshot and demo reel** via email, and include the **character you’re interested in playing in the subject line**.

If you’d like to learn more about me and my work, you can also find me on Instagram at **@giovanna_qb**.

Looking forward to seeing your submissions and hopefully working together!

🎬 **CAST & CREW CALL — INDIE SHORT FILM**

**I : AWAKENING**
Written & Directed by **Bharad Reddy**

**Genre:** Sci-Fi / Thriller / Drama
**Runtime:** ~6 min
**Submission:** Digi60 Filmmakers Contest & Festival 

A **no-budget experimental narrative short** looking for a small cast & crew.

⚠️ **UNPAID / VOLUNTEER PROJECT**
Food + IMDb/film credits provided.
**Non-union only.**

**CAST**

• **Peter** — M, Caucasian, late 20s/early 30s
• **Lucy** — F, Caucasian, late 20s/early 30s
• **2 Extras** — Confrontation sequence / thugs, no dialogue, non-elaborative action(intercuts)
• **1 of the extras may also play a mysterious hooded figure** — no dialogue, dark/ominous presence

**CREW**

• **Swing PA-BTS**
• **Camera Operator** — own camera system preferred; some experience is helpful,
but **please email even if you're newer and interested.**

**Style: Run-and-gun, gritty, emotion, performance-driven.**

📍 **Location:** Toronto Leaside-DonMills area, only 1 location
🎥 **Shoot:** 1-2 days, ~ 6/7 hours/day
☀️ Daytime shooting only(originally intended for night in script)
📅 **Plan to finalize casting as soon as a week & wrap filming as soon as 2-3 weeks, **

Interested? **DM me or email**: **bharadreddyfilms@gmail.com** with your role, **availability** and any relevant work/experience.

Small crew, straightforward shoot, focused on getting the film made asap to ready for contest submission.

Cheers! Happy Filming!

Reddy.

På vegne af Arla, The Barn, søger jeg en håndmodel til vores kommende optagelser. Vi søger en person med hænder og kropsbygning, der ligner personen på de vedhæftede referencebilleder - gerne med en let solbrun hudtone og uden synlige tatoveringer på hænder, arme og overkrop.

Optagelserne foregår i Viby J, Aarhus, og det er en fordel, hvis du bor i Aarhus eller omegn. På optagelserne vil du være iført sportstøj, og kun hænder og overkrop vil være synlige, uden ansigt eller andre genkendelige kendetegn. Jobbet er lønnet, og vi ønsker en aftale med total buyout af rettighederne til materialet.

Er du interesseret og tilgængelig på de nævnte datoer, så send mig gerne en mail med billeder af dine hænder og dig selv samt en kort beskrivelse af dig.

Bemærk, at vi kun kontakter de kandidater, der matcher det, vi søger.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

FUNDET

Miso Film leder efter statister til TV2 serie.

Vi skal lave nogle ekstra optagelser og hertil skal vi bruge nogle statister. 

Optagelserne ligger:

Tirsdag d. 6/10 fra kl. ca. 08:00-18:00 I et storcenter.

Onsdag d. 7/10 fra kl. ca. 08:00-15:00 I et hus.

(Begge steder i Københavnsområdet)

Om tirsdagen, skal vi  bruge cafegæster/handlene i et storcenter og det er her at vi skal bruge flest statister.

Onsdag, skal jeg bruge 2 stk. betjente som skal i politiuniform og 1 stk. som skal være civile betjent, samt 1 nabo.

Er der nogen af jer, der har tid og lyst til at være med én af dagene? 😊

Det er lønnet - 700 kr. for en hel dag og 400 for en halv.

Hvis det har intresse, så send venligst en mail til statistpaafristelsen@gmail.com. Send dit fulde navn, telefonnummer og et vellignende billede af dig selv.

Håber at høre fra én af jer.

MVH 

William

HASTER: MANDLIGT ENSEMBLE SØGES TIL “JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”! 🎭
Alle herrer/mænd i alderen 18-40 år, der ikke allerede har været til audition på Musicalteatrets kommende opsætning af “Jack the Ripper: The Musical”, er velkomne til at tilmelde sig. Der søges IKKE længere personer til roller med replikker/solosang eller kvindelige castmedlemmer. Der søges KUN 2-4 mænd i alderen 18-40 år, som skal indgå i ensemblet og koret. Der lukkes ned for tilmeldinger, så snart de 2-4 mænd er blevet fundet.

Krav: Du skal kunne synge kor i forestillingen (tenor, baryton eller bas). Korerfaring er ikke et krav, men en fordel. Det er heller ikke et krav at kunne danse, men kun et plus, hvis du har erfaring med at bevæge dig til musik.

Prøveperiode: 8. oktober 2026 – 1. marts 2027 på Frederiksberg.
Spilledatoer/spillested: 3.-20. marts 2027 på Folketeatrets Store Turnéscene (København).
Tilmelding: musicalteatret.dk/audition

‘Tag’ gerne potentielt interesserede bekendte i kommentarsporet, og læs mere om at tilmelde sig sang-audition som mandligt kor/ensemble-medlem på Musicalteatrets hjemmeside her: musicalteatret.dk/audition

sharedPost.text:
KITEEZI TRAGEDY
A Story of Tears, Hope, Healing and Restoration
“Every Life Matters”
On 10 August 2024, the Kiteezi community in Kampala experienced a devastating tragedy. Following heavy rains, part of the Kiteezi landfill collapsed, destroying homes and taking the lives of people who never expected that an ordinary day would become their last.
For the affected families, Kiteezi became more than the name of a place. It became connected to memories of loved ones, pain, unanswered questions and tears.
Behind every person who died was a family. Behind every family was a story. Behind every story were dreams, hopes and people who loved them.
The tragedy affected parents, children, husbands, wives, relatives, neighbours and the entire community. Some people lost loved ones, while others lost their homes and possessions. Survivors were left with memories that may remain in their hearts for many years.
For some children, the tragedy meant growing up without a mother or father. For some parents, it meant facing the unbearable pain of burying a child. For relatives, it meant waiting for news and hoping to find their loved ones alive.
The Kiteezi tragedy reminds us how quickly life can change and how important it is to care for one another.
THE SILENCE AFTER THE TRAGEDY
When tragedy happens, the world often sees the pictures, hears the news and discusses the number of people affected. But after the news moves on, the families remain. The tears remain. The memories remain. The questions remain.
There are people who still remember the confusion, fear and desperate search for those they loved. There are mothers who still remember their children, fathers who still remember their families and children who still remember those who cared for them.
There are also survivors who may continue to carry emotional wounds from what they witnessed.
This is why the story of Kiteezi should not simply be forgotten. It should be remembered with dignity, told with compassion and used as an opportunity for people to come together.
TELLING THE STORY THROUGH ART
Through the Kiteezi Tragedy Theatre Production, we want to use the power of performing arts to tell this story.

🎩🕵️ Geheimagent für außergewöhnliche Geburtstagsmission gesucht! 🕵️🎩
Für den 9. Geburtstag meines Sohnes suchen wir eine kreative Person mit schauspielerischem Talent, die Lust hat, Teil eines ganz besonderen Agenten-Abenteuers zu werden.

📅 Wann:

Idealerweise am 31.10. (alternativ 01.11./ 07.11 / 08.11)

📍 Wo:

Unterschleißheim bei München

⏱ Dauer:

Ca. 2 Stunden

👦 Teilnehmer:

Etwa 6 bis 10 Kinder im Alter von 9 bis 11 Jahren.

Die Idee:

Zu Beginn der Feier klingelt ein vermeintlicher Geheimagent an der Tür. Er erscheint in passender Agentenkleidung und sollte auf die Kinder möglichst authentisch und glaubwürdig wirken. Die Kinder sollen wirklich das Gefühl haben, dass ein echter Agent ihre Hilfe benötigt.

Er erzählt, dass er einen gefährlichen Täter verfolgt und dringend Unterstützung bei den Ermittlungen braucht. Gemeinsam mit den Kindern geht er auf Spurensuche, sammelt Beweise, untersucht Hinweise und löst Rätsel.

Wir stellen uns dabei Aktivitäten wie beispielsweise Fingerabdruckanalysen, das Entschlüsseln geheimer Botschaften, versteckte Hinweise, geheime Dokumente, Codes, UV-Hinweise, Tatortspuren oder ähnliche Agenten- und Detektivaufgaben vor. Hier würden wir uns auch über eigene kreative Ideen und Erfahrungen freuen.

Der große Plot-Twist:

Im Laufe der Ermittlungen verdichten sich die Hinweise immer mehr. Am Ende führen alle Spuren zu einem Safe oder einem geheimen Versteck. Dort finden die Kinder schließlich ein Foto des Täters und erkennen überrascht, dass es sich um den Geheimagenten handelt, der sie durch die gesamte Mission begleitet hat.

In diesem Moment wird jedoch die Wahrheit aufgedeckt: Die Agentur wusste bereits von seinem Verrat und hat die Kinder bewusst in die Ermittlungen eingebunden, um seine Tarnung zu entlarven. Die Kinder haben erfolgreich den Fall gelöst und den Täter überführt.

Zum Abschluss werden sie offiziell für ihren Einsatz geehrt und als Nachwuchsagenten ausgezeichnet.

Wichtig:

Wir suchen keine klassische Kinderanimation, sondern jemanden, der die Rolle überzeugend spielen kann und Freude an Improvisation und Storytelling hat. Die Kinder sollen für etwa zwei Stunden vollständig in die Geschichte eintauchen können. Ziel ist ein Erlebnis, das sich möglichst wie ein spannender Agentenfilm anfühlt.

Wir haben bereits viele Ideen für Story, Rätsel und Ablauf und würden diese gerne gemeinsam weiterentwickeln.

Die Tätigkeit wird selbstverständlich angemessen vergütet.

Falls du Interesse hast oder jemanden empfehlen kannst, freuen wir uns über eine Nachricht mit ein paar Informationen zu dir sowie gerne Fotos, Referenzen oder kurzen Videos.

Vielen Dank!

Anna

items.text:
CZEŚĆ WARSZAWA!

Poszukuje na jutro (5.10, poniedziałek) 

Epizodysty do roli doktora ( stawka 300 zł godziny pracy 14-18)

Epizodystki do roli pielęgniarki ( stawka 300 zł , godziny pracy 14-18)

Epizodysty do roli pacjenta ( stawka 200 zł i możliwość ponownego zagrania tej roli w tym tygodniu, za tą samą stawkę godziny pracy 14-18 i drugi dzień do ustalenia) 

12 statystów ( stawka 250 zł, godziny pracy 14-21)

Plan filmowy znajduje się w szpitalu na ul Działdowskiej, statyści później jadą z nami do lasu nagrać parę scen, nagrywamy film fabularny typu horror dla dzieci, na kanał YouTube „Tritsus” 

Z każdym podpisujemy umowę, oraz płatność gotówką od razu po zakończeniu zdjęć na planie.

🚨 $40-$50/HR NEXT WEEK!!!
Branded Promo Talent, a leading experiential marketing agency, is seeking dependable, outgoing, and professional Event Managers and Brand Ambassadors for brand launch activations across five markets next week!

Dates, Times & Locations:
📍 Memphis, TN
Mon, Oct 5 → Tues, Oct 6, 2026
11:00 PM–7:00 AM

📍 Raleigh, NC
Mon, Oct 5 → Tues, Oct 6, 2026
10:00 PM–6:00 AM

📍 Cleveland, OH
Thurs, Oct 8, 2026
1:00 AM–7:00 AM

📍 Jacksonville, FL
Weds, Oct 7 → Thurs, Oct 8, 2026
10:00 PM–7:00 AM

📍 Kansas City, MO
Thurs, Oct 8, 2026
8:00 AM–4:00 PM

All times are onsite hours and include setup, activation, and breakdown for both roles.

Compensation:
• Event Managers: $50 per hour
• Brand Ambassadors: $40 per hour

— 1099, paid weekly —

Event Managers will receive additional paid hours for offsite pickups and returns.

Event Details:
Help introduce new products from a national food brand to employees, warehouse teams, and drivers before they reach the market. The activation will feature product sampling, food, refreshments, giveaways, and an onsite raffle.

Event Manager Duties:
• Coordinate logistics, lead the onsite team, and manage event flow.
• Pick up and return event supplies at Southwest Cargo near the airport.
• Collect Walmart orders containing food, refreshments, and event supplies.
• Transport equipment and lead team setup, breakdown, and loading.
• Oversee sampling, food and refreshments, giveaways, and raffle participation.
• Complete a recap report through Google Forms and upload event photos to Google Drive.

Event Manager Requirements:
• Must have a truck, SUV, or van capable of transporting a 10×10 tent, table, backdrop, banner, premiums, and supplies.
• Must be available for pickups and returns before and after the event.
• Must have prior Event Manager experience and strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
• Must lead by example, actively performing Brand Ambassador duties while guiding and supporting the team.

Brand Ambassador Duties:
• Assist with unloading, setup, breakdown, packing, and loading.
• Welcome employees and drivers and introduce products using approved messaging.
• Assist with product sampling, food, refreshments, and giveaways.
• Encourage raffle participation and explain entry instructions.
• Keep the activation clean and organized while supporting smooth guest flow.
• Support the Event Manager and represent the brand professionally.

Staff Expectations:
We are looking for punctual, dependable, and engaging staff who work well as a team. You must be comfortable assisting with setup and breakdown and working the full scheduled shift, including overnight hours where applicable.

Application Process:
To be considered, email chrissy@brandedpromotalent.com with the following:
• Market & Role
• Availability
• Resume
• Headshot
• Relevant experience
• A brief description of why you’re an excellent fit for this role
• Event Managers - confirm you have a truck, SUV, or van to transport assets.

Please use “Brand Launch — [City/Role]” as the subject of your email.

Note: Only applicants who follow all instructions will be considered. Our team will review qualifications via email and schedule a call with eligible candidates.

items.text:
**CASTING CALL — A PROFESSIONAL VICTIM**

I’m looking for **3 male actors and 1 female actor** for **2 R&D scripted readings **of my new play **A Professional Victim** - a story about a refugee poet who moves to London and takes a job as the victim of a serial killer in an immersive horror experience.

This is a self-funded, low-budget R&D project, developed with a view towards a future full production. A small fee is offered for the rehearsals and reading.

**New Wimbledon Theatre Studio**

**3 November 2026 · 7 PM**

**SHAPES Lewisham**

**7 November 2026 · 6 PM**

**MALE 1:** Matthew / Limonov / Paolo / Male Audience Member

**MALE 2:** Jamie / Gazdanov

**MALE 3:** Dave / Border Officer / Male Audience Member

**FEMALE:** Agata / Mother / Literary Critic / Archive Lady  

*(Slavic roots and MOTHER energy preferred.)*

There will be a small number of rehearsals before the reading.

*This play contains scenes and references involving violence, torture, death, sexual exploitation and nudity, domestic abuse, self-harm, suicide, drug and alcohol use, mental-health crisis, war and displacement, and strong language.*

To apply, please send your **CV/Spotlight, showreel and headshot** to **fingersandlungs@gmail.com** with the subject **A PROFESSIONAL VICTIM — CASTING**.

Application deadline: 10 October 2026.

Please share with actors who might be interested.

items.text: Hello everyone! I'm filming several series here in Colorado, but this is probably the most fun! If you ever wanted to be a character on RENO911 now is your chance! Some of my previous clips have 1 to 3 million views! We're looking for goofy, eccentric, fun, outrageous characters! Just a headshot or a recent selfie, and a brief description of what type of character you'd like to play! These shoots take anywhere from 15 to 30 minutes to shoot, and average anywhere between 200k to sometimes 3 million views! Hope to hear from you soon!

# Looking for post production audio crew:

Hello, our ~45-min (Dir's cut) crime based comedy Indie short film titled - Almost Assassin is currently in post production. We are locking the picture in about a week from now. And the music is already in production, in parallel. 

Once the picture lock is done, I would like to get started with sound   design in parallel.

So currently looking for the below:
* Dialogue editor
* SFX Editor
* Foley Artist (We will know what is needed from Foley after editing sfx)
* Re-recording Mixer - To do the final mixing and mastering.

The film is completely in English language.

Note: my Music Director has a mixer of his own, to mix his stems so for the final mastering, the music will be provided as a single mixed track.

We will be targeting full festival runs starting submissions from this December. 

If you fit any of the roles or know someone who does, can you please share and ask to reach out by emailing - talkies.terrace@gmail.com

Please determine your rate, and share the details in the email as well along with your past works. I would prefer link to at least 1 short film. Won't care much for reels :) 

Follow us for latest updates - [https://www.instagram.com/p/DYEGZ4LsPBR/](https://www.instagram.com/p/DYEGZ4LsPBR/)

Thanks for your time!
