items.text:
If your primary work is background, then your city will be just fine as you will have plenty student/independent and some studio work.  Local casting can help you book co-stars..

If your primary work is commercial and guest or starring roles and you utilize travel to work then this may be helpful .

Here’s a forecast of scripted television productions from 2027 through 2031.

UNITED STATES

Production market iEstimated series seasons

Los Angeles 300–400

New York 140–190

Atlanta / Georgia 120–170

Chicago / Illinois 40–65

Albuquerque / New Mexico 15–30

Louisiana 15–35

INTERNATIONAL MARKETS

Recent activity and outlook

United Kingdom Major production growth

Canada Established production hub

Ireland Attracting international productions

Hungary Attracting international productions

Germany Growing international interest

Czech Republic Competitive production destination

Here’s what concerns me.

We’ve spent years building enormous studios across America, including right here in New Mexico. But having a studio in your backyard doesn’t mean a damn thing if nobody’s rolling cameras.

And now we’re competing with entire countries offering attractive tax incentives and lower production costs.

The United Kingdom alone reported £6.8 billion in film and high-end television production spending in 2025, a 22% increase over the initially reported 2024 figures.

Meanwhile, international production is increasingly gravitating toward incentive rich markets.

For established SAG-AFTRA actors pursuing guest-star roles, this raises a serious question.

Are we living where the work is going to be, or where it USED to be or where it’s all wishful thinking?

I’m particularly interested in hearing from working actors, casting directors and crews across these markets.

What are you seeing?

SOURCES: FilmLA, New Mexico Film Office, Georgia Department of Economic Development, Illinois Film Office, Louisiana Entertainment, NYC Mayor’s Office of Media and Entertainment, British Film Institute and ProdPro.

The U.S. figures are speculative, five year estimates, not published forecasts. 

International entries describe reported industry trends rather than comparable numerical projections. 

Production activity does not necessarily translate into local guest-star opportunities.

#SAGAFTRA #WorkingActors #Hollywood #FilmIndustry #FilmProduction #NewMexicoFilm #AtlantaFilm #ChicagoFilm #NYCFilm #InternationalFilm #GuestStar #ActorsLife #HollywoodJobs

Hi everyone!! 🎬 CASTING CALL OPEN!! 🎬

For our Film & Tv Production Course, we are a making a Neo Noir Crime Thriller short film and we are looking for actors!! 

Project Title: Blood on Blue Notes
Project Type: Student Short Film (Under 15mins)
Filming Location: Birmingham, England (+15 mile radius) (Exact locations TBD)
Shooting Dates: November (Exact dates TBD)
Casting Deadline: October 18th (may be extended if roles aren’t filled)
Compensation: Unpaid (unfortunately), but the finished project will be given to you for Showreel/Portfolio material.

Story Summary
A jazz singer turned vigilante, delivering justice one bloodied note at a time.

Character Descriptions

Miss Josephine Rainey
Role: Lead
Age Range: 20-29
Appearance: Black Actor, Entrancing Eyes, glamorous old Hollywood look, star quality
Language: English
Mature Themes: Will be killing on-screen and have on-screen suggestive intimate actions
Other: Singing is required. Strong jazz/blues vocal skills preferred.

Little Miss Birdie
Role: Supporting
Age Range: 20-29
Appearance: Any Race, ‘Betty Boop’ look, petite, younger appearance, contagious smile
Language: English
Mature Themes: On-screen suggestive actions, such as tease/ innuendos
Other: Dancing is preferred (tap, Charleston, foxtrot, jive etc). Possibly Singing required. 

Mama Selma
Role: Supporting
Age Range: 30-50
Appearance: Black Actor, Mature, Full Figure, Glamorous Soulful Look
Language: English 
Mature Themes: There may be on-screen action shots of protective fight/actions, Smoking on-screen (can be made fake if not a smoker) 
Other: N/A

Bit Parts & Extras:
Comedic/Flirty Bartender - Male, 25-35, Any Race (preferably Black)
Criminals - Male, 20-30, White
Doorman - Male, 20-30, White
Jazz Band - Authentic jazz players preferred, All Ages, All Races
Bar Patrons - All Ages, All Races

*all actors including bit parts and extras must wear 1920s costume!!

If you are interested and think you fit the role requirements please send an email to ebony.tearbanner@gmail.com with the following:
• Name
• Age
• Location
• Which role(s) you are interested in
• OPTIONAL Headshots
• OPTIONAL Showreel
• OPTIONAL Acting Resume

You will then be sent your audition scripts for the self tapes, please send your completed self tape back to ebony.tearbanner@gmail.com with any other necessary content.

If you have any issues with email let me know and we can arrange an alternative method.

We can’t wait to see your interpretations!! 🖤

Hi, we are casting for roles in our upcoming project shot on 16mm.  BASED IN LONDON

Here are the descriptions of the characters.

Character name : Jean  

role size : lead

Playing age range : 25-35

Gender : Male

Personality : Jean is an aloof character who believes others can clean up his mess. He is clumsy and careless. He is driven by his need to do what he wants

He is paired on a stakeout with Ella who is his complete opposite. When tasked to work together he learns in the importance of helping others aswell as realising his feelings for her.

character name : Ella

role size : lead

playing age range : 25-35 

gender : female

personality : Ella is an extremely work driven character. She believes she must strive for perfection. She is organized and well kept. She is driven by her need to do everything her way. 

She is paired on a stakeout with Jean who is unreliable and lazy. When tasked to work together she learns that she doesn’t always need to be perfect whilst realising Jean is not as annoying as he seems.

Since it is a student film, we don’t have much of a budget to pay our actors. So this will be a voluntary role. However we will pay for your travel costs and food and drink on set. 

Being so, it is ideal if you’re based in or around London.

To get in touch please email: 45.castingcall@gmail.com 

With your headshots preferably.

**Do you want to make the right impression with your headshots and stand out?**

I’ll be happy to help by working with you on a strong range of believable, impactful looks.

And, as always, including:
* Guidance before, during and after the shoot. 
* A relaxed, creative atmosphere that helps you feel comfortable in front of the camera.
* Help selecting your strongest images on the day (or remotely online).
* Professional studio lighting in a controlled and safe environment (yes - I can even bring the studio to your living room). No distractions, no passers-by, no battling the weather. 

If you want to work in the comfort of your home (or another convenient location), I can come with the studio to you. If you don't mind travelling, you're welcome in my studio in Grantham, Lincolnshire.

𝗦𝘂𝗰𝗵𝗲 𝗦𝘆𝗻𝗰𝗵𝗿𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗽𝗿𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗲𝗿 𝗳𝘂̈𝗿 𝗲𝗶𝗻 𝗽𝗿𝗶𝘃𝗮𝘁𝗲𝘀 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗷𝗲𝗸𝘁 (𝗼𝗵𝗻𝗲 𝗕𝗲𝘇𝗮𝗵𝗹𝘂𝗻𝗴)

Hallöchen ich habe mich vor gewisser Zeit dazu entschieden eine Fortsetzung eines Buches mit der Thematik Mafia zu verfassen und diese in eine animierte Serie weiter zu verarbeiten 

Für diese Serie suche ich noch einige Leute die den Charakteren ihre Stimme schenken möchten 

Wichtig: dies ist ein Projekt was nicht veröffentlicht wird daher bitte ich beteiligte es ebenso nicht zu veröffentlichen und nachzufragen falls sie es ihren Freunden zeigen möchten

Bei Interesse gerne privat schreiben 

Optional wäre es wenn ihr discord habt damit wir da ich die App für die Kommunikation übersichtlicher finde ist dennoch kein muss

## Models/Statisten (w/m/d) für ein Fotoshooting: "Schule in Zeiten der Digitalisierung" gesucht
## 

*****ENGLISH BELOW*****

Wir suchen eine vielfältige Gruppe junger Models im Alter von 16 bis 17 Jahren (du musst die 10. Klasse abgeschlossen haben).

**Allgemeine Informationen:**
**Datum:** 10. October 2026
**Zeit:** 15:00-20:00
**Ort/Adresse:** Berlin-Bezirk Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf
**Thema:** Schule in Zeiten der Digitalisierung
**Gage:** 120 € durch Paypal oder Banküberweisung

Auftraggeber ist eine schwedische Bildagentur www.maskot.se

Erfahrung nicht erforderlich, solange Sie glücklich und selbstbewusst vor der Kamera sind.
Leider können wir uns nur dann bei Ihnen melden, wenn der Kunde Sie auswählt – deshalb möchten wir Ihnen schon im Voraus für Ihre Bewerbung danken!

****************************************************************

We are looking for a diverse group of young models between the age of 16-17 (you have to have finished the 10th class of school)

**General information:**

**Date:** 10th of October 2026
**Time:** 15:00-20:00
**Location/Address:** Berlin-Bezirk Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf
**Theme:** School in the Age of Digitalisation
**Fee:** 120 € through paypal or bank transfer

The client is a Swedish stock photo agency www.maskot.se

Experience is not required as long as you are happy and confident in front of the camera. Unfortunately, unless the client selects you, we will not be able to get back to you – we want to thank you in advance for your application!

items.previewDescription: Sveriges ledande bildbyrå och producent för royaltyfria bilder. Köp och ladda ner svenska bilder från professionella fotografer med ett skandinaviskt bildspråk. Stock photo för all din reklam, marknadsföring och kommunikation.

We’re building the cast and production team 

for Arthur Miller’s The Crucible at The Gladstone Theatre, February 17–20, 2027.

All ages and experience levels are welcome, with Grade 9 as the minimum age. We’re looking for speaking roles, smaller roles, ensemble/extra roles, and people who want to help behind the scenes.
See the poster for full audition and rehearsal details.
To audition or volunteer:
connect@nataliefraser.ca
Come be part of something meaningful — onstage or behind the scenes.
#TheCrucible #OttawaTheatre #OttawaAuditions #CommunityTheatre #TheGladstone #OttawaArts
